title: Separación, divorcio y relaciones familiares
summary: The book Separation, divorce and family relationships. A multidisciplinary analysis is the result of a collective work of academics and professionals, in which the processes of separation and divorce are addressed from a legal, sociocultural and psychosocial perspective, offering an interdisciplinary analysis of said process, its causes and the effects that They can manifest in family members, both in adult ex-spouses and in sons and daughters.
